name: EEG Montage
desc: A twenty-channel polysomnogram drawing itself across the chart paper: posterior alpha waxes and dies as the patient drops from wake into N2, sleep spindles and K-complexes fire under the pen, eye-movement channels swing hard in REM and blink artifacts punch through the frontals — the whole montage restaging itself every section.

energy.doc: amplifier sensitivity — trace amplitude (channels start colliding at max)

density.doc: channel count in the montage (6 to 20)

scale.doc: paper speed / timebase — horizontal zoom of the trace

speed.doc: rate multiplier for events and staging

hue.doc: paper + ink hue (offset from the style anchor)

style.doc: aesthetic: aged paper polygraph with red grid and black ink / dark ICU monitor with luminous traces / white-on-cyanotype / radically abstracted — every channel collapses to a false-colour amplitude density band, no wiggle at all

act.doc: multi-minute programme: a full descent W→N1→N2→N3→REM / quiet wakefulness with alpha and muscle tone / recurring 3 Hz spike-and-wave seizure runs
